patterns.fact: 33 of 43 programs ask for a solo at some stage (video, live audition or callback), and 20 of those 33 say outright that your own choreography is fine.
UNCSA, Temple and CalArts (video route) require the solo to be self-choreographed, Utah's live solo is self-choreographed, and Ohio State says it prefers a solo you made yourself.
Only 1 program, Ailey/Fordham, says the solo should be choreographed by a teacher or professional rather than by you.
Of the 30 programs that give a solo length, 22 cap it at 2 minutes or less, and 7 allow or ask for more than 2 minutes (Oklahoma wants at least 3 minutes of modern).
13 programs want a solo of 90 seconds or less at some point (Purchase stops solos that run long), so have a tight 60 to 90 second cut ready next to the full 2 minute version.
5 programs require two solos in contrasting styles, and 2 more allow an optional second solo in a different style.

5 programs limit solo style: Montclair wants modern or contemporary with no aerials or backflips, Shenandoah bans classical variations and tap, UNCSA wants classical or art music, NYU bans pointe, and Tampa requires a modern or contemporary solo.
8 programs say performance or competition footage is fine for the solo video, while FSU says a solo pulled from a recent competition or performance must be refilmed in a studio in class clothes.
13 of 43 programs require a video from every applicant (a prescreen or a required upload); most of the rest are live-first and take video only if you cannot attend.
18 programs put ballet on the video route, and 11 of them ask specifically for a filmed ballet barre.
9 programs make you learn their own demo combinations from a class video and film them to the school's audio.
13 programs want a short spoken intro or slate on camera (name, background, why this school, or the solo's title and choreographer).
Only 5 programs spell out what men wear, and 2 of them (UNCSA on video and Oklahoma's ballet track) name a dance belt.

The men's rules that are stated line up: a fitted solid, black or white tee (tucked into the tights for ballet at Oklahoma), black or solid tights, and ballet slippers; Temple adds footless tights and bare feet for modern and African.
17 programs ask all dancers for fitted dancewear that shows the body line, nothing baggy, and 5 of them say solid colors.
Indiana is the exception on clothes: long pants preferred, no tights or leggings, nothing too tight or too bulky, and bring sneakers and tap shoes if you own them.
Pack ballet slippers and be ready for bare feet: 15 programs name ballet slippers, and 11 say modern or contemporary is danced barefoot.
18 of 43 programs ask for a headshot.
First arabesque photos are requested by 7 programs and tendu a la seconde by 3 (Florida Southern and Ailey/Fordham want both).
18 of 43 programs ask for a dance resume, 17 ask for an essay, statement or short written answer, and 16 ask for at least one recommendation letter (8 want two).
Acceptd is used by 7 programs and SlideRoom by 2 (USC and Ohio State); most others use their own application portal or email.

Fees vary a lot: Point Park charges a $150 artistic review fee, Pace $90 at the Acceptd upload, Elon $80, Montclair $65 audition plus $65 application, Purchase $65 audition plus $50 application, and Utah and Indiana $50.

film_day.tip: Keep your whole body in frame head to toe the entire time, with no zooming or close-ups.
Put the phone on a tripod or a table, still and facing you straight on.
Light the room well, ideally from the front and the side.
Wear class clothes, not a costume, and no props.
Pick clothes that contrast with the wall behind you; no dark clothes on a dark background.
Fitted dancewear only, nothing baggy: ballet slippers for ballet, bare feet for contemporary or modern.
Wear a dance belt under your tights: UNCSA requires it for men on video, and Oklahoma ballet adds a solid tee tucked into black or grey tights.
Open with a slate: your name, the solo title, the choreographer and the music.
Dance the solo in one continuous take with no cuts, effects or music laid over it.
Film it fresh: UNCSA and Northeastern want footage from the last 3 months, Montclair 6 months, Elon one year.
Dance alone in the frame; no group numbers or other dancers.
Do ballet combinations on both sides unless the school says otherwise (UNCSA and Peridance want one side only).
Learn each school's demo combos to its exact audio before film day; NYU's class video is open for only 4 hours.
If your solo is competition choreography, refilm it in a studio in class clothes for FSU.
Check the upload rule before you export: Juilliard takes portal uploads only (no YouTube), Oklahoma and Utah refuse Google Drive links, and NYU and Montclair want YouTube or Vimeo links.

video.length: Not to exceed 3 minutes total, with 1-2 minutes of dancing
video.rules: Upload to the Portfolio section of the FSU Admissions portal at least 1 week before your in-person audition or you are removed from the roster. Film horizontally (landscape) with the full body in frame, in class attire (not a costume), as recent as possible. Open with a waist-up intro stating dancer's name, solo title (if any), choreographer, music title, and composer. Do not submit a solo pulled from a recent performance or competition; the choreography can be from one, but it must be filmed in a studio in class attire.

solo.style_rule: Any dance style of the applicant's choosing

florida-state-university.essay: Resume must include a statement of career goals and highlight dance training and experience; the FSU university application also asks for an essay (prompt not given on the dance page)
florida-state-university.mens_attire: Ballet: close-fitting appropriate dancewear and ballet shoes (and/or pointe shoes). Contemporary and improvisation: close-fitting appropriate dancewear and bare feet.
florida-state-university.notes: The solo video is required on top of an in-person audition (Oct 28, 2026, Jan 13, 2027, or Feb 10, 2027); Early Decision is not allowed for dance, and the School of Dance will not consider applications submitted after Dec 8, 2026.

video.rules: Video audition only if you cannot attend in person; you must first do a virtual interview with dance faculty (email dance@arts.ufl.edu to schedule), then the degree coordinator sends video instructions.

university-of-florida.notes: Email 2 recs (one from a dance teacher if possible), a one-page resume, and a headshot to dance@arts.ufl.edu by Oct 30, 2026 (for the Nov 6 audition) or Jan 22, 2027 (for Jan 29); audition class covers contemporary, ballet, contemporary African diasporic dance, and composition, then a faculty interview; register via the Microsoft Form.

video.rules: Three videos via Acceptd: (1) Ballet: barre both sides (grand plies in 1st, 2nd, 5th in profile; passe balance; degage combination), center (adagio with developpes front, side, arabesque; pirouettes right and left; petit allegro; grand allegro), with in-place alternatives if space is tight; pointe optional. (2) Contemporary/commercial: replicate USF's demo videos from the Acceptd Resources tab (standing warmup once facing camera and once in profile, leg swings across the floor both sides, across-the-floor combination both sides, contemporary combination, commercial combination). (3) Solo: state your name and the choreographer at the start; stage or competition footage is allowed if you put the choreographer in the file name.

solo.length: 90-120 seconds on video; 90 seconds or less at the in-person audition
solo.style_rule: Any style

university-of-south-florida.mens_attire: All dancers: ballet in black leotard, skin-colored tights, and ballet slippers; for contemporary, tight-fitting dancewear may go over the tights and leotard, bare feet.
university-of-south-florida.notes: Choose in person (Oct 23, Nov 20, 2026; Jan 15, Feb 12, 2027; registration via Cognito form, confirmation email required) or video on Acceptd (deadline Feb 25, 2027); must place into at least level I ballet and contemporary to declare the BFA.

video.length: About 5 minutes of technique plus a 1-minute solo, after a short intro
video.rules: Email the video as a link (not a file) to mlburns@mdc.edu. Intro: name, where you are from, why the NWSA BFA interests you. Technique (5 minutes total): modern/contemporary in place across levels plus traveling with turns, falls, and jumps at slow and fast tempos; ballet barre examples, center adagio, across the floor (waltz, petit and grand allegro). Music preferred with clear sound; space big enough to move; full body in frame at all times; camera stationary and straight on (may pan in a large space); zoom only if the full body stays in view.

solo.style_rule: Modern/contemporary, ballet, or jazz; classical or contemporary repertoire, or an original work

new-world-school-of-the-arts.mens_attire: Close-fitting black or white t-shirt; black, pink, or skin-tone tights (adjustable for bare feet), ballet slippers, and jazz shoes; no large jewelry.
new-world-school-of-the-arts.fee: NWSA fee not stated on the dance page; the college apply page lists a completed online UF application with a $30 fee paid to UF
new-world-school-of-the-arts.notes: In person is strongly recommended (bring solo music in two formats); the listed 2026-2027 audition weekdays (Fri Nov 14, Jan 23, Feb 27, Mar 20) match the 2025-26 calendar, so the dates may be stale; 2 recs go to jhodgson@mdc.edu.

video.rules: Recorded audition only under special circumstances (such as international students); details come from Admissions Counselor Wesley Chandler (wchandl1@ju.edu). The page's Electronic Auditions section is empty.

jacksonville-university.mens_attire: All dancers: neat, clean attire that allows clear observation; hair secured off the face; no large jewelry.
jacksonville-university.notes: Live audition required (short ballet barre, ballet center, contemporary section, improvisation; no solo mentioned) on Jan 15, Feb 19, or Apr 2, 2027 via apply.ju.edu registration; apply for the artist scholarship together with admission; the CFA audition page still says Fall 2026.

video.rules: If you live too far from an audition site, a video can be submitted for provisional consideration only, followed by a live audition and interview on campus; no video specs given.

solo.style_rule: Student's own choice of dance style

palm-beach-atlantic-university.essay: An essay describing your interest in dance
palm-beach-atlantic-university.notes: Also requires a Prospective Dance Major Form and a rec from a high school dance teacher or dance professional; audition is ballet and modern classes plus a solo and faculty interview (dates Nov 20, Dec 12, Feb 12, Mar 6, Apr 17, year not stated).

video.rules: Video option for applicants outside Central Florida or unable to come to campus; specs not posted, request them at danceauditions@flsouthern.edu.

florida-southern-college.mens_attire: All dancers: leotard and tights, ballet slippers and bare feet; hair secured away from the face, no large jewelry.
florida-southern-college.notes: Photos (full body in frame for tendu and arabesque en l'air, no costume or performance photos; headshot need not be professional) and one rec from a dance teacher upload with the registration form; in-person audition is ballet barre, center, contemporary modern phrase work, improv, then solo and interview (2026-27 dates Oct 5, Jan 23, Feb 20, Mar 19; Jan and Feb are for admitted students only).

video.length: About a 10-minute ballet barre plus across the floor, and a 1-1.5 minute solo (optional second solo)
video.rules: Barre: plies, tendus/degages, rond de jambe, frappe, fondu/developpe. Across the floor: battements front and side, pirouettes (parallel or turned out), grand jete or saut de chat. Submitted through the SpartanStart portal after applying; no filming specs given.

solo.style_rule: Required modern or contemporary solo; optional second 1-1.5 minute solo in another style of your choice

university-of-tampa.notes: Audition can be submitted digitally or done in person at an official admissions open house; March 1 deadline for scholarship consideration; contact director Susannah LeMarquand (slemarquand@ut.edu) to schedule.

video.length: 10 minutes maximum
video.rules: Introduce yourself with full name and the term you are applying for. Ballet barre: plies, tendus, degages, rond de jambe, barre adagio, grand battements. Ballet center: center adagio, pirouettes, petit allegro, grand allegro. Short modern sequence showing levels and dynamics; short jazz sequence showing musicality and performance. No studio needed but the space must be safe and the camera must show you clearly. Hair secured away from the face. Send a private YouTube, Google Drive, or Dropbox link. No late videos.

solo.style_rule: No solo or individual choreography is required.

photos: photo in dance clothes similar to audition attire
valencia-college.mens_attire: White shirt and black tights (or comfortable, tight clothing); ballet shoes if owned. Same for in-person and video.
valencia-college.notes: In-person audition is a technique class (ballet barre and center, modern, jazz); the application is a Valencia online form, and fall 2027 entry auditions are listed for April 24, 2027 (apply by April 16) and June 26, 2027 (apply by June 18), with no statement that video applies to those dates.

university-of-central-florida.mens_attire: All dancers: appropriate dance attire and shoes; no tennis shoes, street shoes, or bare feet; hair up and away from the face.
university-of-central-florida.notes: In-person only, once a semester (ballet and jazz combinations, tap optional; registration on site); you must already be a registered UCF student with a declared major, so John cannot audition until he is enrolled at UCF.

video.length: Not stated overall; the solo is about two minutes and the improvisation is the first 30 seconds of the provided track
video.rules: Five separate videos recorded in order: introduction (close-up from shoulders up: name, city and country, training history, why you are auditioning), prepared solo, ballet center (Juilliard's combinations from the demonstration video: tendu with pirouette, adagio, traveling pirouette, petit allegro, grand allegro, both sides), modern (Juilliard's combination, both sides), choreography and improvisation (improvise on three gestures from the phrase as solid, liquid, gas, then the phrase). Ballet and modern may be recorded in pieces but must be edited together; section five must be one continuous take with no edits, using the provided audio. Upload only through the online application, never YouTube or Vimeo. Unitard, or tights and tight-fitting top, or leotard; no skirts, loose tees, leg warmers, or costumes; clothing should contrast with the background. Good front and side lighting, minimal distractions, stay in frame. Files up to 5GB.

solo.length: About two minutes for the prescreen; no more than two minutes at the in-person callback
solo.style_rule: Ballet, modern, or contemporary, to music; state title, choreographer, and composer before dancing; at the callback, chosen to show range and projection, no elaborate costumes or props

juilliard-bfa-dance.essay: 1 to 2 pages, double-spaced, 12-point: how you first became interested in dance and what inspires you to continue at the collegiate and professional level; how you learned about Juilliard and why you chose the Dance Division; how conservatory training fits your goals and how Juilliard will help you reach them. Must be your own writing, no AI.
juilliard-bfa-dance.mens_attire: All dancers: unitard, or tights and tight-fitting top, or leotard; no skirts, loose-fitting tee shirts, leg warmers, or costumes. For the in-person audition bring ballet slippers, dance socks, and be ready to dance barefoot.
juilliard-bfa-dance.notes: Fall 2027 page: everything due December 1, 2026 (recs by December 15), prescreen results December 22, in-person NYC auditions Feb 21, 27, 28 and March 1, 2027; recs are one academic teacher (English or history preferred) and one dance teacher; the demo video link arrives within 12 hours of starting the application.

solo.style_rule: Should be professionally choreographed by a teacher or choreographer

photos: tendu a la seconde (arms in second)
ailey-fordham-bfa.essay: Ailey dance application: an essay on your professional goals. Fordham Common Application: a separate essay (prompt not stated on the Ailey page).
ailey-fordham-bfa.mens_attire: All dancers (photos): ballet shoes, leotard, and tights.
ailey-fordham-bfa.fee: Ailey dance application is free; $45 audition fee if invited; Fordham charges a Common Application fee (amount not stated)
ailey-fordham-bfa.notes: Two applications (Ailey dance application with training details, two photos, and goals essay, plus Fordham Common App with counselor rec and transcripts) both due November 1, 2026; the prescreen is the application, auditions are by invitation (notice by December 1), and video audition is offered only to international applicants.

video.rules: NYU emails a personal Dance Artistic Review Portal link after the Common App (allow up to 10 days). Learn ballet center (no barre) and contemporary combos from the Tisch class video (open for 4 hours), then submit one video of your final performance of all combos, synced to the class audio. Any well-lit space, studio not required; whole body in frame, tripod recommended; 16:9 horizontal. Ballet shoes for ballet (no pointe), bare feet for contemporary, no baggy clothing. Upload as unlisted or link-only on Vimeo or YouTube titled with your full name and BFA.

solo.style_rule: No pointe solos

nyu-tisch-dance.mens_attire: All dancers: no specific clothing required; wear something that shows the body clearly, not baggy; ballet shoes for ballet, bare feet for contemporary, no pointe shoes.
nyu-tisch-dance.notes: 2026-27 cycle; the portal also takes an audition form and resume; callback is ballet and contemporary class, improv, the solo, and a short interview (NYC, or Chicago/LA for Regular Decision, virtual option); Regular Decision prescreen due January 18, 2027, ED I due November 2, 2026.

solo.style_rule: Classical or contemporary ballet, modern, or contemporary dance; music played from your phone; be ready to introduce title, choreographer, and composer

photos: 8x10 full-body dance photo in leotard and tights, first arabesque preferred
suny-purchase-dance.essay: College essay: bring a copy to the audition (prompt not stated on the dance page)
suny-purchase-dance.mens_attire: All dancers: no costumes; attire that lets faculty clearly see your movement.
suny-purchase-dance.fee: $50 application fee plus $65 non-refundable audition fee
suny-purchase-dance.notes: In-person only (Feb 6, 12, 20, 26, 2027; apply by Feb 1, portfolio by Feb 8): ballet class, modern/contemporary center and across the floor, improv, then finalists do the solo and an interview; the one rec is artistic, sent by the recommender to admissions@purchase.edu.

video.length: Two solos, each no longer than one minute, plus a video response of no more than 60 seconds
video.rules: Recent existing or new footage; studio ideal, professional video not required; full body in frame, close to camera, phone held horizontally; no jump cuts, dissolves, or musical overlays; competition footage and site-specific work allowed, one partnering example allowed if you are easy to identify; no group numbers or reels. Video response: introduce yourself and describe a specific setback in dance that challenged how you saw yourself as an artist, what choices you made, and what you would do differently today; unscripted.

solo.length: Each no longer than one minute
solo.style_rule: Two contrasting pieces in any style; you define and explain the contrast; improv or freestyle allowed

usc-kaufman-bfa.essay: Short answer, 250 words or less: what role you naturally play among the dancers you train with, and what your peers would say you bring to the room.
usc-kaufman-bfa.notes: Portfolio plus USC application due December 1, 2026; resume is one page on the official template; Kaufman does not consider rec letters (they go to USC Admission); finalists notified by December 18 for live auditions January 16-17, 2027.

video.rules: Film each segment separately and submit four separate videos: ballet, hip hop, jazz and modern. Page does not say who may use video or give lengths.

solo.style_rule: No solo: the guidelines say solo variations are not accepted.

photos: full-body first arabesque (8x10) for ballet, jazz or modern concentrations
point-park-bfa-dance.mens_attire: All dancers: ballet and modern, solid color leotard or fitted top and tights or unitard; jazz, solid color leotard or fitted top with tights, black leggings or unitard, bare feet or jazz shoes; hip hop, loose or form-fitted dancewear (sweats, basketball shorts, tanks, t-shirts) with sneakers. Hair off the face, no hats, bandanas or headbands.
point-park-bfa-dance.fee: $150 artistic review fee (non-refundable), paid after completing the artistic application in Acceptd
point-park-bfa-dance.notes: In-person audition opens with a required ballet class for all, then modern, jazz and hip hop; academic application must be filed before scheduling, and March 15, 2027 is the best-consideration date for merit scholarships.

video.length: Ballet barre 6 to 10 minutes plus center; modern/contemporary/jazz phrase 1 to 2 minutes; solo 1 to 2 minutes
video.rules: Ballet barre and center in one video, combinations shown on both sides; center includes degages, pas de bourree, pirouettes en dedans and en dehors, petit allegro, and grand allegro if space permits. Phrase should show level changes, torso articulation, breath and isolations, ideally in a different style from the solo. Solo recording must be made within the past three months. Interview video: introduce yourself, name your solo's choreographer and inspiration, your approach to training, academic interests, what brings you joy in dance.

solo.length: 2 minutes in person; 1 to 2 minutes for digital submission
solo.style_rule: Any genre

northeastern-nyc-marymount-dance.notes: In-person audition (NYC or Oakland) is encouraged and requires the separate Dance Application plus a 2-minute solo; digital materials are uploaded in the Application Status Check; recs are Northeastern's general rule of one teacher plus one counselor.

video.rules: Pre-recorded ballet and modern material is required only for the online audition format and is due 48 hours before it; the solo and interview happen live on Zoom. An entirely recorded audition is allowed only if you cannot do in-person or online. Barre: plie, tendu or degage from fifth, rond de jambe or fondu, grand adagio with developpes en croix. Center: pirouettes en dehors and en dedans, petit allegro with jetes, assembles and battu, grand allegro from the corner. Modern: floor warm-up and standing phrases with levels, extensions, off-center movement; traveling phrases with jumps, falls and turns. Submission instructions are sent after registering.

solo.style_rule: Repertory or original; ballet or modern preferred but not required; applicant provides the music

boston-conservatory-contemporary.essay: None: the Conservatory says it does not require essays or personal statements.
boston-conservatory-contemporary.mens_attire: All dancers: solid-colored leotard and tights, or solid-colored T-shirt and tights, or solid-colored unitard.
boston-conservatory-contemporary.fee: Application fee $75 through November 1, $150 through December 1; no separate audition fee stated
boston-conservatory-contemporary.notes: No pre-screen for dance; a faculty interview is required; Early Action deadline November 1 with early audition dates (Nov 14, Nov 21, Dec 5 online, Jan 3 Atlanta, Jan 5 Chicago, Jan 7-8 NYC, Jan 16 campus).

video.length: One video file, no more than 10 minutes total (barre max 5 minutes)
video.rules: Single file, full body in frame throughout, no other dancers, recorded within three months of submission, one side of each barre combination only, clothing that contrasts with the background. Barre: plie, tendu/degage, rond de jambe, passe developpe front/side/back, grand battement, balance in attitude back. Ballet slippers for barre, bare feet or socks for solo.

solo.style_rule: Self-choreographed, performed to classical or art music (suggested: Bach, Beethoven, Joplin, Copland, Ellington, Philip Glass)

photos: facing front in pointe tendu a la seconde, arms in second
uncsa-dance.essay: Two-page artistic statement on your interests, goals and other insight into your work, with your full name on it.
uncsa-dance.mens_attire: Leotard or tight-fitting t-shirt with convertible tights or a unitard, ballet slippers; for video, a dance belt must be worn by male dancers.
uncsa-dance.fee: $95 application fee (US); $130 international; non-refundable, waiver available
uncsa-dance.notes: Video and on-campus are equal choices (on-campus Jan 30, Feb 6, Feb 13, 2027); priority date Nov 2, 2026 gets out-of-state applicants an earlier video decision; recs are one arts and one academic instructor.

video.rules: Only for applicants who cannot attend a live audition. Ballet: adage, petit allegro, grand allegro. Contemporary phrase traveling across the floor with jumps, turns and floor work. Solo in any genre, choreographed and performed by the applicant.

solo.style_rule: Any dance genre, choreographed and performed by the applicant (video only; no solo at live auditions)

calarts-dance.essay: Artist statement, at least one paragraph each: what is most important to you as a person and as a dancer and why; your artistic and personal goals; why you are applying to the CalArts BFA in Dance.
calarts-dance.mens_attire: All dancers: form-fitting dancewear, no color requirement; live audition is danced barefoot, in ballet slippers and in sneakers.
calarts-dance.fee: Application fee $65 by December 1, 2026 preferred deadline, $85 by January 5, 2027; a separate portfolio submission fee exists but the amount is not listed
calarts-dance.notes: Live audition strongly recommended (about 10 events Oct to Feb, on campus and select US cities); at least one rec should know his dance work.

video.length: Intro 1 minute or less; solo 90 to 120 seconds; technique sections follow the school's demo videos
video.rules: Learn and re-create the three SMU demonstration videos (ballet, modern, jazz) using the same audio; ballet barre alternates sides right, left, right. New or recent footage preferred; any setting is fine (stage, studio, backyard, gym). Faculty may follow up with a Zoom interview.

solo.style_rule: Ballet (classical or contemporary), modern, or jazz, candidate's choice; music on phone, computer or USB

smu-meadows-dance.essay: Short written response to a prompt in the Meadows Dance Application; faculty say they are not looking for an essay.
smu-meadows-dance.mens_attire: All dancers: form-fitting dancewear such as full-length non-footed tights and form-fitting tops or leotards; no loose t-shirts, baggy pants or shorts. Bring ballet slippers and jazz shoes; modern is barefoot.
smu-meadows-dance.notes: Live audition is the default (campus Oct 31 or Nov 21, 2026 for EA/ED I; NYC Jan 16 and Houston Feb 5, 2027; or at REVEL, NYCDA, BOCA); recorded deadlines Nov 1, 2026 and Feb 1, 2027; Presidents' and Hunt scholars must audition in fall.

video.length: No more than 3 minutes total
contents: phrase in a supporting dance form
video.rules: Solo or solo excerpt showing your strengths, performance or studio footage both acceptable; recordings must have no artificial enhancement; upload in the Media Upload section of the Jacobs Supplemental application by December 1.

solo.length: Prescreen solo within the 3-minute total; live audition solo 1 minute
solo.style_rule: Choreographed by a dance professional, self-choreographed, or improvised

indiana-contemporary-dance.mens_attire: All dancers: dress neatly, long pants preferred with no tights or leggings, tops covering back and abdomen, neither too tight nor too bulky; bring tennis shoes and tap shoes if owned. Solo may be in standard performance attire.
indiana-contemporary-dance.notes: Invite-only live audition after prescreen (Jan 29, Feb 5, Feb 26, 2027); letter(s) of recommendation required at the supplemental stage but the count is not stated.

video.length: Not to exceed 10 minutes
video.rules: Upload to YouTube or Vimeo and attach the link to the online registration form; no Google Drive. Modern attire: solid colored unitard or top and bottom with no feet. If no studio access, requirements may be modified or omitted to fit available space safely. A separate registration and video is needed if also auditioning for Ballet.

solo.style_rule: A modern dance solo

photos: full length photo in dance attire (JPG; first arabesque is specified for ballet applicants only)
oklahoma-dance.essay: 400-500 words: your background and training, why you are interested in the OU School of Dance, and what unique qualities you may contribute. Submitted in the DanceApply application.
oklahoma-dance.mens_attire: All dancers (modern video): solid colored unitard or top and bottom with no feet. Ballet video men: solid color t-shirt tucked into tights, dance belt, full-length black or grey tights, ballet shoes.
oklahoma-dance.notes: Video is a screening round: the Dec 11, 2026 video deadline leads to a Feb 6, 2027 live callback audition on campus (the Oct 1 round has passed), and callbacks may include a brief faculty interview.

video.rules: Video only for those unable to attend an in-person date; deadline April 1, reviewed rolling. Learn the school's YouTube phrases, dance the improv along with the school's prompt video, then submit ONE YouTube or Vimeo link with all four excerpts combined in full (give the password if protected); no Google Drive.

solo.style_rule: Any dance form or style; not expected to be modern/contemporary

utah-contemporary-dance.mens_attire: All dancers: come prepared to move, no specific dress code required.
utah-contemporary-dance.fee: $50 non-refundable audition fee (waiver by emailing info@dance.utah.edu)
utah-contemporary-dance.notes: In-person auditions Nov 14, 2026 and Feb 13, 2027 (ballet barre, contemporary technique, improv, then the 1-2 minute self-choreographed solo); a separate University of Utah admission application is also required.

video.rules: Virtual auditions run on a rolling basis through April 1 via Acceptd; current video contents are not stated on wmich.edu.

western-michigan-dance.notes: The only official video guideline page is dated to a Feb 19, 2018 deadline (ballet center work both sides, jazz combo under 2 min, modern center and traveling combos 30-60 sec each), so it is old-cycle; current requirements live on the Acceptd listing (app.getacceptd.com/wmudance), which blocked fetching. On-campus dates Nov 20, 2026 (register by Nov 16) and Feb 26, 2027.

contents: school's own combo (modern, ballet, and African phrases, emailed on request)
intro/talking video (recorded answers to interview questions)
video.rules: Video only for applicants over 150 miles away or with conflicts with the in-person dates; request it by emailing dance@temple.edu. All video materials go to Acceptd only, not the applicant portal.

solo.length: In person: 1:00 minimum, 1:30 maximum. Video: 1 minute.
solo.style_rule: Must be self-choreographed; show basic elements of composition, with music that reflects your artistic vision

temple-dance.mens_attire: Male presenting: solid color shirt, tights, and ballet slippers for ballet; solid color shirt, footless tights, and bare feet for modern and African. No loose fitting items or warm-ups (no chance to change during the audition).
temple-dance.fee: $35 Acceptd fee for video submissions; no in-person audition fee stated
temple-dance.notes: Resume is 'if applicable'; in-person dates Dec 5, 2026, Jan 30, Feb 13, Apr 3, 2027 (modern, ballet, African workshop, then solo and faculty interview), with headshot, resume, audition form and liability form emailed by the Thursday before, and the Temple university application must be submitted first.

video.rules: Online audition is an accommodation for those who cannot attend in person: record faculty-taught movement phrases (from an online instruction video) and the creative prompt at home on a personal device and upload. Winter online videos due Jan 23, 2027.

solo.style_rule: Faculty prefer a solo choreographed by you, or made with your choreographer, or an improvisation score you created; you also respond to another dancer's solo with movement and a verbal response

ohio-state-dance.essay: A current draft of your Common App essay for Ohio State Admissions, plus background on your training, experience, goals, and outside interests.
ohio-state-dance.mens_attire: All dancers: comfortable clothing with clear and simple lines; best to wear a bright colored leotard or top; bare feet and ballet shoes, no pointe shoes.
ohio-state-dance.notes: No headshot or dance resume and no rec letters required (one from a core academic teacher or counselor is encouraged); in-person is strongly preferred, with autumn app deadline Oct 16, 2026 (audition Oct 31) or winter Jan 16, 2027 (audition Jan 30), and fee waivers by email though no fee amount is listed.

video.length: Solo under two minutes
contents: school's own combo (ballet and jazz instructional videos on Acceptd)
video.rules: Solo can be filmed in a studio or as a featured dancer (performance footage allowed).

pace-commercial-dance.fee: $90 non-refundable audition fee at Acceptd upload (one payment covers multiple programs)
pace-commercial-dance.notes: Pre-screen deadline Jan 4 (Pace application due Dec 1, Early Decision Nov 1); callbacks evaluate ballet, jazz, tap, and hip-hop in small groups, some with a final interview.

video.rules: Video auditions accepted for admission alongside the October, January, or March/April auditions, then rolling until July; contents not stated on the page (contact Abigail Schubert, 405-208-4955).

solo.style_rule: Pre-rehearsed solo in a style the dancer chooses

oklahoma-city-university-dance.fee: Nonrefundable registration fee; amount shown only on Eventbrite
oklahoma-city-university-dance.notes: In-person audition is tap, jazz, and ballet class plus the solo, with required attendance at Dance with the Stars Day the day before, a Dancer Questionnaire, an OCU academic application, and minimum ACT 21 / SAT 1060 / GPA 3.33; October Advantage (Oct 23-24, 2026) deadline is Oct 14, 2026, and January audition (Jan 29-30, 2027) registration closes Jan 19, 2027.

video.length: 2 solo videos, each at least 1 minute and no more than 4 minutes
contents: second solo in a different style
video.rules: Two different styles (contemporary/modern, ballet, pointe, tap, jazz, hip hop, African dance or other African diaspora styles). Studio or alternative movement space (dance film location, competition, intensive) is fine; spacious, well lit. No group dance videos. Hold phone horizontally. Put your name and the choreographer's name in the file title, on screen, or in the description. May be recorded within the last year.

solo.style_rule: The 2 solos must be 2 different styles

photos: full body dance shot (any movement or position)
elon-dance-performance-choreography.fee: $80 audition application fee (non-refundable; fee waiver request due one week before the prescreen deadline)
elon-dance-performance-choreography.notes: Prescreen is required, then invited dancers attend an on-campus group class (technique + improv) and faculty interview; 2026-27 cycle prescreen deadlines are Sept 15 (fall dates, passed) and Dec 7, 2026 for the Jan 15 or Jan 29, 2027 auditions; no virtual auditions; separate Elon admission due Jan 10, 2027.

video.length: 2 to 3 minutes
video.rules: One modern or contemporary solo filmed in a studio, outdoors, or in performance, recorded within the past six months. Start with a slate (verbal or on screen) giving name, home state, and choreographer(s). Optional second 2 to 3 minute solo in a different genre with the same slate. YouTube or Vimeo links only, submitted through the dance portal (no email or links in documents). Clothing must show movement and alignment: no dark clothing on dark background, no oversized or loose clothing, hair off the face.

solo.length: Prescreen 2 to 3 minutes; live audition solo 1 minute
solo.style_rule: Modern or contemporary; live solo may differ from the prescreen solo; no aerials, backflips, or no-hand gymnastic moves

photos: full-body dance pose showing line, form, and expression
montclair-state-bfa-dance.essay: Personal statement (prompt not stated on the page)
montclair-state-bfa-dance.mens_attire: All dancers: clothing that lets faculty see movement and alignment; avoid dark clothing on a dark background, oversized or loose clothing, and hairstyles that cover the face
montclair-state-bfa-dance.fee: $65 audition fee plus $65 university application fee
montclair-state-bfa-dance.notes: Recs = one academic teacher + one dance professional (emailed to msuadm@montclair.edu); video is not reviewed until everything is in; invited dancers then do an in-person or virtual audition day (contemporary class, improv, solo in person); ballet is not part of the audition.

video.rules: Dance must audition live; a recorded submission may be requested by emailing admit@su.edu only for internet stability issues or audition day conflicts (contents not stated).

solo.style_rule: Contemporary, modern, jazz, or commercial styles; no classical ballet variations, no tap; no costumes (performed in class attire); music on a phone or iPad

photos: dance photo showing movement (e.g. arabesque or jump)
shenandoah-bfa-dance.mens_attire: All dancers: no costumes; solo is performed in the same dance attire worn during the classes
shenandoah-bfa-dance.notes: In-person audition days Oct 30 and Nov 20, 2026, Jan 29 and Feb 19, 2027 (ballet, contemporary/modern, commercial jazz classes, creative exercise, solo, 7 to 10 min interview); bring printed resume, headshot, and dance photo; only transfers must self-choreograph.

video.length: 2 contrasting solos, about 60 seconds each
video.rules: Video is for those who cannot attend a live in-person or virtual audition; you must request a form from your Admissions Advisor to submit. Full body head to toe in frame, no close-ups; stationary camera (tripod or table), in focus, well lit, no background noise. Start by stating the date, full name, city and country, program, and titles of pieces; at the end announce the end, restate your name, then stop.

solo.style_rule: Contrasting styles from ballet, contemporary ballet, jazz, modern, tap, ballroom, hip-hop, theatre dance, world dance, street dance, contemporary or cultural styles; no props or costumes

amda-bfa-dance-theatre.essay: Personal essay, 500-word minimum: describe a challenging experience in your life and what you learned from it
amda-bfa-dance-theatre.mens_attire: All dancers: form-fitting dance attire that shows the line of the body; footies, soft jazz shoes, ballet shoes, character shoes, sneakers or bare feet for the solo; no socks; long hair pulled back; no jewelry
amda-bfa-dance-theatre.notes: Live audition (campus, national, or Zoom) is the default; the coach may teach extra movement phrases, so bring all dance shoes; if using someone else's choreography, ask their permission; optional 32 bars + monologue to be considered for other programs.

video.length: No more than 2 minutes
video.rules: Any dance style; any location (studio, stage, bedroom, backyard); does not need to be professional quality but must clearly show movement skills; a clip from a class or past performance is fine if it is a solo. MP4 or MOV, or a public YouTube or Vimeo link, uploaded under Portfolio as Solo Dance Performance Video.

solo.style_rule: Any dance style

rider-ba-dance.notes: The video is for technical placement only and does not affect admission to the BA Dance program; uploaded via the Be A Bronc applicant dashboard.

video.rules: On-campus audition is encouraged; video accepted on request by emailing dance@csulb.edu after submitting the university application, and video instructions are sent by email.

csulb-dance.mens_attire: All dancers: close-fitting dance clothes in solid colors that show alignment and range of motion; longer hair pulled back from the face
csulb-dance.notes: Fall 2027 first-years apply on Cal State Apply (Oct 1 to Nov 30, 2026), email dance@csulb.edu for the department audition application, then audition Feb 26, 2027 (9am or 1pm) in a class with phrase work in modern, ballet, jazz, and street/club (choose two styles); no solo is listed for first-years, only for transfers.

video.length: Intro video 60 seconds or less; dance solo about 2 minutes
video.rules: Intro: medium shot (chest up), state name, hometown, performing experience, and why Chapman. Dance: no zooming, close-ups, or editing within the video; must include floor transitions, jumping, balancing, traveling, and full-body expansion; two shorter pieces allowed if you have more than one dance form. Credit the choreographer if not your own. Files near 2 GB should be compressed; convert .mov to mp4 if it fails.

solo.style_rule: Any style; should show a wide range of technique and artistry

photos: photo of yourself for identification (headshot not required)
chapman-dance.essay: Creative Supplement Goal Statement, 500 words or fewer: why you are pursuing this well-rounded training, why you fit the department, and how it supports your goals
chapman-dance.notes: All dance applicants enter the BA in Dance (BFA is applied for in sophomore spring); Creative Supplement is due 5 days after the application deadline (Nov 1 recommended), then select applicants get a live audition in person or virtually; an optional extra creative recommender can go through the Common App.

video.rules: Video is for students who do not live near an audition site; Ailey recommends attending in person if possible for scholarship consideration. Video contents are not published.

ailey-school-certificate.notes: 2027 cycle: in-person registration and video submission open Nov 17, 2026, audition tour Jan to Apr 2027, video deadline May 4, 2027; ages 17 to 23 by program start with 3+ years of ballet and modern; video specifics are only visible inside the Admissions Portal.

video.length: Solo no more than 3 minutes; optional improv footage 2 minutes or less; ballet barre and center length not stated for Jazz & Contemporary
video.rules: Video is for dancers unable to attend an in-person or Zoom audition. Footage should be recent; solo may be on-stage or in the studio. Ballet barre (plie, tendu, rond de jambe, adagio with developpe en croix) and center (adagio, pirouettes, grand allegro) are mandatory for year-round Trainee applicants; improv is optional. Link must be publicly viewable (YouTube, Vimeo, Dropbox, OneDrive, Google Drive).

solo.length: No more than 3 minutes (the upload form says 2 to 3 minutes)
solo.style_rule: Contemporary, jazz, or modern

joffrey-nyc-jazz-contemporary-trainee.fee: Digital audition $45 per the auditions page ($40 per style shown on the digital form); in-person $43 early or $47 walk-in, Zoom $45; plus $150 Trainee/BFA registration fee that goes toward first-term tuition ($50 refundable on cancellation)
joffrey-nyc-jazz-contemporary-trainee.notes: Ages 13 to 25 (no older than 25 on Sept 1); Trainee digital auditions accepted year-round; the digital form also has a required arabesque photo upload field, which the page labels as the ballet-style photo.

video.length: Contemporary solo 2 to 3 minutes (Ballet/Contemporary track); other lengths not stated
video.rules: Ballet/Contemporary track: 3 complete barre exercises of your choice (one side only), center adagio, pirouette and grand allegro, plus a 2 to 3 minute contemporary solo. Commercial track: 2 exercises of your choice in contemporary, jazz, modern or theatre dance (64 counts each) plus 2 solos in a style of your choice. Videos must be uploaded to YouTube or Vimeo.

solo.length: 2 to 3 minutes (Ballet/Contemporary track); not stated for the Commercial track's 2 solos
solo.style_rule: Style of your choice; Commercial track lists theatre dance, hip hop, popping, waacking, voguing, house, jazz, tap, or other street styles

peridance-certificate.essay: Personal essay up to 1 page, single spaced, on who you are and what you hope to achieve in your training and dance career. The video form also asks for a cover letter (introduction, why you suit the scholarship, how you would benefit, how you heard about Peridance).
peridance-certificate.notes: In-person or video audition (in-person dates TBA); video goes through Peridance's JotForm; ages 17 to 25 with high school done by start; posted deadlines are for Fall 2026 (domestic June 30), so 2027 dates are not out yet; the arabesque photos appear as form fields, not in the track descriptions; also needs proof of high school completion.

video.length: Intro video 30 to 60 seconds; strongest-style dance video 30 to 60 seconds; combination length not stated
video.rules: Learn BDC's required audition combinations from their YouTube playlist using their Dropbox audition tracks. Intro states name, age, hometown and why you want ProSem. Strongest-style clip can be a reel, improv, or class footage. Shoot horizontal if filming on an iPhone. Upload to YouTube or Vimeo set to public or anyone-with-link.

solo.length: 30 to 60 seconds (dance reel or strongest-style clip, not a formal solo)
solo.style_rule: Your strongest style(s)

bdc-professional-semester.notes: Ages 18+ with 10+ years of training; Fall 2027 runs Aug 30 to Dec 17, 2027 (apply by July 2, 2027), when John would still be 17, so Spring 2028 may be the realistic entry; also needs state ID or passport; optional in-person NYC audition; recommendation letter is a required upload on the form but not listed on the program page.

video.length: Solo no more than 3 minutes; other sections not stated
video.rules: Technique: plies, tendus, adagio, pirouettes, petit allegro and grand allegro, both sides. Artistry: solo in your preferred style. Vocal: 16 to 32 bars of a song of your choice showing range and ability.

solo.style_rule: Your preferred style

steps-conservatory.fee: $60 application fee (domestic), $250 (international); live audition also has a class fee, amount not stated
steps-conservatory.notes: Live or video audition, applicant's choice; Fall 2027 semester (Aug 16, 2027) application and audition deadline March 1, 2027; ages 17 to 24, high school graduates; live auditions are never Wednesdays, Fridays or weekends.

video.rules: Application asks only for a link to a video of you dancing; no content or filming rules stated.

millennium-certificate.notes: Rolling Monday starts, 2 to 12 months at $1,200 per month, open to all levels in Studio City, CA; no age rule stated; the application is a form on the program page itself.

video.length: Two solos, about 60 seconds each
video.rules: Video is for those unable to attend a live in-person or Zoom audition. Full body head to toe in frame, no close-ups; device on a tripod or table; in focus, well lit, no distracting background noise. Open by stating the date, full name, city and country, program, and piece titles; at the end announce the end and restate your name. Video is submitted through a form you request from your Admissions Advisor.

solo.style_rule: Contrasting styles from: ballet, contemporary ballet, jazz, modern, tap, ballroom, hip-hop, theatre dance, world/cultural dance, street dance, or contemporary

amda-la-dance-theatre.mens_attire: All dancers: form-fitting dance attire that shows the line of the body; footies, soft jazz shoes, ballet shoes, character shoes, sneakers or bare feet; no socks, no props or costumes, jewelry removed (in-person audition guidance).
amda-la-dance-theatre.notes: AMDA's site lists the Conservatory Certificate at the New York campus, while LA offers dance through BFA and AOS degrees, so confirm which program and campus fits; existing choreography needs the choreographer's permission; an optional 32-bar song and 60 to 90 second monologue widen consideration to other programs; also requires transcripts.
